title: Cautious Advancement
description: Han Li demonstrates perfect patience. 'Haste leads to waste. Every step must be calculated.'

challenge.requirements: Wait 100 turns without taking any risky actions while opportunities pass
challenge.restriction: Cannot use time acceleration or shortcuts

title: Accumulation Mastery
description: Han Li shows the power of gradual accumulation. 'Small gains compound into overwhelming advantage.'

challenge.requirements: Build power through 1000 small improvements without major breakthroughs
challenge.restriction: Cannot use sudden power gains or lucky encounters
